title: At the pharmacy
setting: You've had a sore throat for two days. You go into a neighbourhood pharmacy (*eczane*), where pharmacists often give advice before you see a doctor.
goal: Describe a symptom, answer the pharmacist's questions and check how to take a medicine.

nodes.en: Hello, come in. How can I help?

replies.en: Hello. My throat hurts.
Hello. Does your throat hurt?
replies.why: *Boğazınız* is the pharmacist's throat. Yours is *boğazım*: *Boğazım ağrıyor.*

react.tr: Benim mi? Hayır, benim boğazım iyi!
react.en: Mine? No, my throat is fine!

replies.en: Hello. I'm throat aching.
replies.why: What aches is the throat, and it's yours: *Boğazım ağrıyor*, “my throat is aching”.

react.en: Is it your throat that hurts?

nodes.tr: Geçmiş olsun. Ne zamandan beri ağrıyor?
nodes.en: Sorry to hear that. Since when has it been hurting?
nodes.note: *Geçmiş olsun*, “may it be over”, is said to anyone ill or in trouble. The answer: *Sağ olun* or *Teşekkür ederim*.

turn.prompt: Thank the pharmacist, and say it's been hurting for two days.

replies.en: Thank you. It's been hurting for two days.
Thank you. It's been hurting for two days.
Thanks. It's been hurting for two days.
Thank you. In two days.
replies.why: *İki gün sonra* is **in** two days, from now. **For** two days, up to now, is *iki gündür*.

react.tr: İki gün sonra mı? Yani, ne zamandan beri?
react.en: In two days? I mean, since when?

turn.prompt: Say whether you have a temperature.

replies.en: No, I don't have a temperature.
Yes, I have a slight temperature.
No, you don't have a temperature.
replies.why: *Ateşiniz* is the pharmacist's. Yours: *Hayır, ateşim yok.*

react.tr: Ben mi? Ben iyiyim. Ya siz?

nodes.tr: Ateş varsa bir doktora görünmeniz lazım. Bu sokakta bir sağlık ocağı var.
nodes.en: If there's a temperature, you should see a doctor. There's a health centre on this street.
nodes.note: A *sağlık ocağı*, now officially *aile sağlığı merkezi*, is the neighbourhood's family doctor. Pharmacists send you there when it's more than a cold.

turn.prompt: Ask where it is. Or ask whether you can't just take a medicine.

replies.en: Where exactly is the health centre?

replies.tr: Ama sadece boğazım ağrıyor. Bir ilaç alamaz mıyım?
replies.en: But it's only my throat. Can't I just take a medicine?
You need to see a doctor.
replies.why: That repeats the advice back: *görünmeniz* is about the pharmacist. You're the one going: *Sağlık ocağı nerede?*

react.en: Me? You're the one who's ill!

nodes.en: On the corner, next to the post office. Get well soon!
nodes.end: You're off to the health centre to have the temperature looked at.

nodes.en: Are you allergic to any medicine?

turn.prompt: Say whether you have an allergy.

replies.en: No, I'm not.
Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
No, I don't have any medicine.
replies.why: The question was about **allergies** (*alerji*), not whether you have medicine: *Hayır, alerjim yok.*

react.en: Allergies. Are you allergic to anything?

nodes.tr: Tamam, bu önemli bir bilgi. Bu pastillerde antibiyotik yok, rahat olun.
nodes.en: Okay, that's important to know. There are no antibiotics in these lozenges, so don't worry.

turn.prompt: Say good, and thank the pharmacist.

replies.en: Good, thank you.
Great, thank you.

nodes.tr: Bu pastillerden günde üç tane alın. Bu şurubu da yemekten sonra alın.
nodes.en: Take three of these lozenges a day. And take this syrup after meals.

turn.prompt: Check: is the syrup before or after meals?

replies.en: The syrup's after meals, isn't it?
accept: Şurubu yemekten sonra alıyorum, değil mi?

replies.en: The syrup's before meals, isn't it?
How many a day?
replies.why: You've just been told: *günde üç tane*, three a day.

nodes.tr: Hayır, sonra! Yemekten sonra, aç karnına değil.
nodes.en: No, after! After eating, not on an empty stomach.

turn.prompt: Repeat it, to show you've got it.

replies.en: Okay, after meals.
Got it: on an empty stomach.
replies.why: Not on an empty stomach: *aç karnına değil*. After meals: *yemekten sonra*.

nodes.tr: Hepsi iki yüz kırk lira. Başka bir şey var mı?

turn.prompt: Say no thanks, and ask whether you can pay by card.

replies.en: No, thank you. Can I pay by card?
accept: Hayır, teşekkür ederim. Kartla ödeyebilir miyim?

replies.en: No, thank you. Do you take cards?
No, thank you. Do you take cards?

nodes.en: Of course. Here's your receipt. Get well soon!
nodes.end: You have lozenges and a syrup, and you know how to take them.

phrases.note: What hurts takes the possessive: *başım ağrıyor*, my head aches.
`-DIr` counts a time up to now.
What you're allergic to takes the dative.
